items.headline: Google launches Gemini 4 Hydrogen as its new fast model with a free tier and four thinking levels
items.summary: Hydrogen replaces 3.8 Flash as Google's everyday model. It scores 51 on the Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index at default effort, adds an xhigh thinking level, and costs $1.50/$7.50 per million tokens.
items.why: Hydrogen slots in as Google's go-to model for developers and consumers, with benchmark scores edging past Argon at a fraction of the cost. Its free-tier availability and new xhigh thinking mode give Google a direct counter to Anthropic's Fable 5.2 launch days earlier.

items.headline: Anthropic launches self-hosted Managed Agents so enterprises can run the full service on their own infrastructure
items.summary: Teams can now store agents, sessions and history locally instead of on Anthropic's servers. Model requests go to the provider of their choice. Access requires contacting the Anthropic account team.

items.headline: OpenAI safety team finds four training factors erode chain-of-thought monitorability in frontier models
items.summary: Base-model capability, architecture choices, reinforcement learning and distillation all reduce how faithfully models expose their reasoning. Smaller models that reason at length are easier to monitor but cost more compute.

items.headline: Pre-orders open for Samsung's Android XR glasses with Gemini built in
items.summary: Warby Parker and Gentle Monster opened pre-orders Nov 12 for Samsung's first Android XR Intelligent Eyewear. The audio-only frames include Gemini, a camera and work with both Android and iPhone. Ships December.
